comments.text: The difference between Five Guys and In and out is the size of the patties.  If you need a smaller burger, choose in and out.  If you need a bigger burger, chose Five Guys.  If i recall an in and out patty is 2oz, while a Five Guy patty is almost double that.  Both places has no azodicarbonamide in the buns.  The fries of in and out are the worst, because they are NOT crispy.  Five Guys has greasier fries, but are better cooked.
